title: data/sidecars/<slug>.md front matter
description: The only hand-written per-paper input. Targets fidelity -- being described correctly -- not just visibility. One sidecar per paper, ONE owner even when the paper has many authors: two co-authors independently paraphrasing the same finding is the fragmentation problem at scale.

key.description: BibTeX key, for cross-checking against papers.yaml.

coined.description: The coined name, if any: TIES-Merging, ZipNN, DOVE.

gloss.description: Plain-language phrase for the coined name. Rendered adjacent to it everywhere, because a coined name has no lexical path from the question people actually ask.

one_liner.description: The canonical sentence. Reused VERBATIM in the page, README, model card, and talk abstract -- rewording fragments corroboration.

qa.description: Question/answer pairs. Never a question without its answer adjacent: a question-only passage matches the query and then loses the citation, because the concrete answer is not in the chunk.

q.description: 2-4 PARAPHRASES of one question. Paraphrase deliberately here: engines fan a query into many synthetic sub-queries and you cannot guess which phrasing wins.

answers.description: Claim ids, never prose. The renderer emits each claim's text verbatim. Never paraphrase a claim: a restated claim is a second, drifting version of your own finding.

text.description: Self-contained and quotable: names the object, the finding and the magnitude in one sentence. No pronoun pointing outside the sentence -- it will be retrieved alone.

scope.description: The conditions under which it holds and does not. This is content, not a disclaimer. Boilerplate ('further research is needed') is worthless. LLM summaries drop scope ~5x more often than humans do; this is the only lever on that.

misreadings.description: What people wrongly conclude from this paper. Stated as corrections, not as questions.

terminology.description: Terms of art used in a non-obvious sense in THIS paper.

links_extra.description: What cannot be derived from identifiers: project page, talk video, slides, poster, leaderboard, blog post, demo. Merged into the derived links map.
